d: An honest police officer is falsely implicated after challenging the political system of his jurisdiction. However, he decides to continue his fight against the system and prove his innocence.
JB, a borderline psychopath, is attracted to Lalita, a beautiful, young woman. He forces her to marry him but she runs away on her wedding day by feigning unconsciousness.
Two brothers go after the international mafia kingpin who murdered their cop brother. They are later joined by another man who wants revenge against the gangster.
